Frequency once per round

Your limbs are fitted with advanced hydraulic pistons to increase their power, allowing you to exert more force using your arms, legs, and other appendages. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Quick Jump] skill feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites. In addition, your fist gains the boost d4 and tech traits, and you don't take the normal –2 circumstance penalty when making a lethal attack with your fist. When you get a critical hit with your fist, you gain the critical specialization effects of unarmed attacks.
